'''Elite Flight Alpha''' was an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] that fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It fielded elite [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid fighters]] that were often used to supplement other [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]]. The [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid fighters]] were enhanced with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|launchers]] in addition to their standard configuration.<ref name="SWPM TCG">{{PocketModel|set=Base Set|cardname=Elite Flight Alpha Droid Tri-fighter|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/ship15c.jpg}}</ref>
